// A deterministic 2D rotational velocity field rendered with vector arrows.
import std.viz

fn main() -> Void {
    xs = linspace(-3.0, 3.0, 17)
    ys = linspace(-2.4, 2.4, 13)
    mut origins_x: List<Float> = []
    mut origins_y: List<Float> = []
    mut us: List<Float> = []
    mut vs: List<Float> = []
    for yi in 0 until ys.length() {
        y = ys[yi]
        for xi in 0 until xs.length() {
            x = xs[xi]
            radius = sqrt(x * x + y * y)
            factor = if radius > 0.2 { 1.0 / (1.0 + radius * 0.35) } else { 0.0 }
            origins_x.push(x)
            origins_y.push(y)
            us.push(0.0 - y * factor)
            vs.push(x * factor)
        }
    }

    fig = viz.figure("2D rotational velocity field")
        .describe("Sampled vectors with deterministic arrowheads and tooltips")
        .labels("x", "y")
        .xlim(-3.2, 3.2)
        .ylim(-2.6, 2.6)
        .quiver(array(origins_x), array(origins_y), array(us), array(vs), 0.24, "velocity", "#2563eb")
    print(fig.svg())
}
